# Lab 14.3: Vector Indexes & VECTOR_SEARCH

## What We Are Going to Do
Search embeddings with VECTOR_SEARCH, first by brute force, then with IVF and TreeAH vector indexes, and compare speed and results.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Brute-force search.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT base.title, distance
FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
  TABLE lab14.so_emb, 'emb',
  (SELECT AI.EMBED('reduce query cost in bigquery', endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb),
  top_k =&gt; 5, distance_type =&gt; 'COSINE',
  options =&gt; '{"use_brute_force": true}');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create an IVF index.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE VECTOR INDEX so_ivf ON lab14.so_emb(emb)
OPTIONS (index_type = 'IVF', distance_type = 'COSINE', ivf_options = '{"num_lists": 100}');</span>
</code></pre>

3. **[SQL] Wait for the index, then search with it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT index_name, index_status, coverage_percentage FROM lab14.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VECTOR_INDEXES;

SELECT base.title, distance
FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
  TABLE lab14.so_emb, 'emb',
  (SELECT AI.EMBED('reduce query cost in bigquery', endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb),
  top_k =&gt; 5, distance_type =&gt; 'COSINE',
  options =&gt; '{"fraction_lists_to_search": 0.05}');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Searching 5% of the lists is faster; recall may be slightly lower than brute force.

bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "CREATE VECTOR INDEX so_tree ON lab14.so_emb(emb) OPTIONS (index_type = 'TREE_AH', distance_type = 'COSINE')"</span>

5. **[Console] Compare jobs.** In **Job information** for each search, check **Vector index usage** and slot time.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Brute force | Exact, reads every vector |
| IVF | Clusters vectors into lists |
| TreeAH | ScaNN-based, good for large batch searches |
| Trade-off | Speed vs recall |
